k8s.iam.clusterrole_has_declared_consume.purpose: A declared RBAC or aggregation consumer helps identify ClusterRoles that may still be needed; observed use is separate.

k8s.iam.clusterrolebinding_subjects_exis.purpose: A ClusterRoleBinding with no existing subject may leave an obsolete grant; external identity existence needs separate evidence.

k8s.iam.legacy_serviceaccount_token_rece.purpose: The tracked last-use date helps review legacy ServiceAccount tokens; it does not cover untracked or manual tokens.

k8s.iam.role_has_declared_consumers.purpose: A declared RBAC consumer helps identify Roles that may still be needed; observed use is separate.

k8s.iam.rolebinding_subjects_exist.purpose: A RoleBinding with no existing subject may leave an obsolete grant; external identity existence needs separate evidence.

k8s.iam.serviceaccount_has_declared_cons.purpose: A workload, binding, token or cloud identity reference can justify retaining a ServiceAccount; external use is separate.

k8s.network.endpoints_controller_service.purpose: The controller-owned Endpoints reference is compared with the current Service UID; endpoint traffic is separate.

k8s.network.endpointslice_service_refere.purpose: The EndpointSlice Service label is compared with current same-namespace Services; endpoint traffic is separate.

k8s.network.ingress_service_backends_res.purpose: The Ingress backend names are checked against current same-namespace Services; controller routing is separate.

k8s.network.networkpolicy_selects_curren.purpose: Current Pod selectors indicate whether this NetworkPolicy matches a captured Pod; future Pods and CNI enforcement are separate.

k8s.network.service_has_current_backend_.purpose: Current Pod selectors and EndpointSlice addresses show declared Service backends; readiness and traffic are separate.

k8s.review.selected_flux_artifact_secret.purpose: Offline inspection covers the selected verified Flux artifact bytes; detected values remain hidden and are not validated.

k8s.review.selected_registry_image_high_.purpose: A fresh complete scan of the selected Pod image identifies recorded HIGH or CRITICAL package vulnerabilities; runtime image use is separate.

k8s.review.selected_registry_image_secre.purpose: Offline inspection covers the selected verified Pod image bytes; detected values remain hidden and are not validated.

k8s.review.selected_text_content.secret_.purpose: Offline inspection covers explicitly selected Kubernetes text fields; detected values remain hidden and are not validated.
